payload.title: Search Console verification for anth.us and subdomains
payload.description:
SEARCH CONSOLE verification (thread "Search Console DNS verification", 2026-10-18).
VERIFIED by Ryan: chatticus, cyclotron, hard-decisions. OPEN: anth.us, biased-decisions.anth.us, primus.anth.us, p.apyr.us (re-check), pilobol.us.
FACTS: anth.us and apyr.us are delegated to Route 53 zones in papyrus-production (712236451410); anth.us zone Z04979341DPRV5BDQNZMG. TXT tokens were added there (anth.us keeps the OpenAI TXT value plus the Google token RNx6_2...). biased-decisions.anth.us serves token rKlyMW... Public resolvers (8.8.8.8, 1.1.1.1) show all tokens.
TODO: Ryan clicks Verify again for anth.us and biased-decisions.anth.us. If anth.us still fails, Search Console's domain-property token differs: paste the exact current token and add it as an extra TXT value on the anth.us apex in zone Z04979341DPRV5BDQNZMG (keep existing values). primus.anth.us has a CNAME to CloudFront so cannot hold a TXT; verifying anth.us as a DOMAIN property covers it. Also check whether Search Console shows anth.us as indexed (marketing review asked).
